# Cineguru Studio — AI Video Production & Filmmaking

> Cineguru Studio is an Istanbul-based video production studio combining artificial intelligence technology with human creative direction.
> Cineguru Studio, yapay zekâ teknolojileri ve insan kreatif gücünü bir araya getiren İstanbul merkezli video prodüksiyon stüdyosudur.

## Services / Hizmetler
- **AI Video Production / Yapay Zekâ Video Prodüksiyon**: AI-assisted creative visual generation and film direction.
- **Commercials & Brand Films / Reklam ve Tanıtım Filmleri**: High-end commercials, launch films, and brand stories.
- **Vertical Video & Social Content / Dikey Video ve Sosyal Medya**: Vertical video production for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.
- **Event & Cultural Films / Etkinlik ve Kültür Filmleri**: Live event documentation, festivals, and brand experiences.
